_meta.note: Structured choice/state graph for all 40 choices in CHOICES.md. This is the mechanical structure (options, skill/flag effects, gates) — NOT the narrative prose for each scene, which is separate, larger authoring work not yet done. See STATE_MODEL.md for how this data drives divergence and endings.

choices.title: Which teacher to seek out first

options.label: Rigorous scholastic training first
options.detail: Formal madrasa training — orthodox, respected, and no faster route into Akhlati's more radical circle.

options.label: Seek unconventional teachers immediately
options.detail: Skip the madrasa. The unconventional circles are where Sayyid Husayn Akhlati actually teaches.

choices.title: How openly to align with Akhlati

options.label: Declare discipleship openly
options.detail: Everyone will know you study under Akhlati — respected by his admirers, flagged by his enemies.

options.label: Study quietly, keep it deniable
options.detail: Study with Akhlati quietly. Deniable for now — and he may trust you less for it.

choices.title: How to treat the friendship with Yazdi

options.label: Collaborate as equals
options.detail: Treat Yazdi, your sharpest student, as a genuine partner, not a subordinate.

options.label: Mentor him at arm's length
options.detail: Keep Yazdi at a teacher's distance. Safer authority, a shallower bond.

choices.title: How close to stand with Qasim-i Anvar

options.label: Bond deeply as fellow-travelers
options.detail: Bond deeply with Qasim-i Anvar. Real loyalty — and his risks become yours.

options.label: Keep a respectful distance
options.detail: Keep Qasim-i Anvar at arm's length. Safer, and less to lean on later.

choices.title: Which lineage to foreground

options.label: Commit to Ibn 'Arabi's tradition
options.detail: Foreground Ibn 'Arabi alone — the famous, fiercely contested half of the tradition.

options.label: Elevate Hamuya instead
options.detail: Elevate the lesser-known Sa'd al-Din Hamuya instead — a bolder, riskier claim.

options.label: Insist on both (the historical choice)
options.detail: Insist on both Ibn 'Arabi and Hamuya as co-founders — harder to argue, truer to what you believe.

choices.title: Accept patronage at all

options.label: Accept the court appointment
options.detail: Accept Iskandar Sultan's court appointment. Security now, tied to his fortunes.

options.label: Remain independent
options.detail: Stay unaffiliated. No patron owns your time — none protects you either.

choices.title: How much doctrine to reveal to Iskandar Sultan

options.label: Present the full, still-forming system
options.detail: Show Iskandar Sultan the full, unabridged system. Impressive — and now he knows all of it.

options.label: A court-palatable, watered-down version
options.detail: Offer the prince a safer, watered-down version. He never really knows what he's funding.

choices.title: Align with the atelier's artists, or stand apart

options.label: Collaborate with poets and painters
options.detail: Join Iskandar Sultan's atelier of poets and painters. Your ideas gain color; your seriousness gets questioned.

options.label: Keep to philosophy and law
options.detail: Stay apart from the atelier. Respected, and a little outside the court's real influence.

choices.title: React to the first flicker of rival jealousy

options.label: Flaunt the theory to build reputation fast
options.detail: Flaunt the theory now. Reputation grows fast — so does the list of rivals watching.

options.label: Introduce it cautiously
options.detail: Let it spread quietly, by word of mouth. Slower, and harder for anyone to attack.

choices.title: Loyalty as Shah Rukh moves against Iskandar Sultan

options.label: Stay loyal as he is blinded and executed
options.detail: Stand visibly by Iskandar Sultan as Shah Rukh destroys him. Reckless now, unforgettable if you survive it.

options.label: Distance yourself before the executioner arrives
options.detail: Quietly court Baysunghur before the axe falls. Safe -- and nothing left to call in later.

choices.title: How to present himself anew at Baysunghur's court

options.label: Lead with manuscript-arts affinity
options.detail: Open with the manuscript arts, Baysunghur's own passion, and win him as a craftsman.

options.label: Lead with astronomical prestige
options.detail: Open with Samarkand's rising prestige. Impressive, more distant than a shared craft.

choices.title: Whether to work on the Baysunghur Qur'an

options.label: Offer a lettrist framing for the calligraphy program
options.detail: Offer a lettrist framework for the Baysunghur Qur'an itself — permanent, and permanently exposed.

options.label: Stay deliberately separate
options.detail: Stay apart from the Qur'an project. Safe, and no mark left on it.

choices.title: Balance judiciary duties against court philosophy

options.label: Let the qadi post lapse into formality
options.detail: Let the qadi post lapse into formality. More hours for philosophy, less legal cover.

options.label: Stay genuinely active on the bench
options.detail: Stay genuinely active on the bench. Real legal standing, at real cost to the work.

choices.title: Pursue a formal tie to the Samarkand Observatory

options.label: Actively seek association through Yazdi
options.detail: Seek a formal tie to Ulugh Beg's Samarkand Observatory through Yazdi. Real weight, real effort.

options.label: Stay Isfahan-rooted
options.detail: Let the friendship with Yazdi carry it instead. Lighter, entirely dependent on him.

choices.title: Respond to a rival's first public challenge

options.label: Answer publicly and immediately
options.detail: Answer the rival publicly, on the spot. Decisive, and irreversible.

options.label: Let it pass
options.detail: Let the challenge pass unanswered. Costs nothing now; reads however the room wants.

choices.title: Primary specialization

options.label: Kimiya (alchemy)
options.detail: Kimiya, alchemy — the most elite science, the slowest to pay off.

options.label: Limiya (talismanry)
options.detail: Limiya, talismanry — binding heaven to earth, one rank below alchemy.

options.label: Himiya (subjugation)
options.detail: Himiya, subjugation — commanding jinn and planets. Commanding fear, too.

options.label: Simiya (illusionism)
options.detail: Simiya, illusionism — shaping what other people believe they see.

options.label: Rimiya (trickery)
options.detail: Rimiya, trickery — the fastest science to learn, the least prestigious.

choices.title: Specialize narrowly or diversify

options.label: Pursue the primary science exclusively
options.detail: Commit to one science alone — the harder, historical path.

options.label: Diversify for steadier income
options.detail: Spread across several sciences. Steadier income, never the deepest master in the room.

choices.title: Mathematical foundation first, or theurgic ambition first

options.label: Build rigorous grounding first
options.detail: Build the mathematics first. Slower to impress; nothing built on sand.

options.label: Lead with bold cosmological claims
options.detail: Lead with the bold cosmological claims. Faster to dazzle, math catches up under pressure.

choices.title: When to go public with the sensory-theory innovations

options.label: Publish early to stake the claim
options.detail: Publish the sensory theory now, against Avicenna's own hierarchy. Bold, and early.

options.label: Hold back until reputation is secure
options.detail: Hold it until your name can absorb the backlash. Patient, possibly too patient.

choices.title: When to finalize and circulate the core diagram

options.label: Publish alongside the observatory's prestige
options.detail: Circulate the Tahawi Circle alongside Samarkand's own rising fame. Maximum attention, minimum polish.

options.label: Take the years needed to refine privately
options.detail: Take the years the diagram needs. Right — and possibly too late to matter as much.

choices.title: Register of the masterwork

options.label: Dense, elite register (the historical choice)
options.detail: Write Investigations dense and demanding, as it actually was. Respected by few, understood by fewer.

options.label: Aim for Kashifi-style accessibility
options.detail: Write toward a Kashifi-style wider readership. More readers, less mystique.

choices.title: Teach widely or keep the circle small

options.label: Recruit and train students broadly
options.detail: Grow the New Brethren of Purity broadly. Harder to erase, harder to trust completely.

options.label: Keep the New Brethren small and trusted
options.detail: Keep the New Brethren small and vetted. Tight trust, total dependence on a few.

choices.title: Write vernacular popularizations alongside the masterwork

options.label: Produce simplified Persian versions
options.detail: Produce a simplified Persian edition alongside Investigations. Wider reach — and it becomes 'you' to most readers.

options.label: Refuse — full difficulty or nothing
options.detail: Refuse to simplify. Full difficulty stands; Kashifi's circle gets the popular audience instead.

choices.title: Handle requests for simplified, practical grimoire content

options.label: Take the income and status
options.detail: Take the commission — a Boon-for-the-Khan-style manual of named operations. Real money, less prestige.

options.label: Decline, protect the work's prestige
options.detail: Decline the popular commission. Prestige intact, income and reach forgone.

choices.title: How fully to name his sources

options.label: Be generous crediting the tradition
options.detail: Credit Ibn 'Arabi and Hamuya generously. Honest — and less of the credit is yours.

options.label: Claim more originality than is strictly true
options.detail: Let your own name carry more credit than earned. Impressive now, dangerous evidence later.

choices.title: Accept the Chief Judge appointment at all

options.label: Take the post (the historical choice)
options.detail: Take the Chief Judge post, the historical choice. Real standing, a second set of enemies.

options.label: Decline to remain scholar-only
options.detail: Decline the judgeship. Purer as a scholar, and less protected.

choices.title: A defining case

options.label: Rule for the powerful patron's interest
options.detail: Rule for the powerful man's interest. Easy today, corrosive to your name as a defender of the weak.

options.label: Rule for the weaker party (the historical reputation)
options.detail: Rule for the weaker party — the reputation history remembers. Costly, and a real enemy made.

choices.title: Occult reasoning on the bench

options.label: Keep judge and occultist personas separate
options.detail: Keep judge and occultist strictly apart. No accusation of sorcery — and no proof of your method either.

options.label: Let lettrist reasoning inform judicial argument
options.detail: Let lettrist reasoning argue the case in open court, a first. It works — and it's now on the record.

choices.title: A case touching a rival occultist

options.label: Show scholarly solidarity and mercy
options.detail: Show quiet solidarity with the accused occultist. Humane, and a pattern someone could notice.

options.label: Enforce orthodoxy strictly
options.detail: Enforce the law strictly. Protects you; condemns someone whose real difference is getting caught.

choices.title: Where peak years go

options.label: Prioritize the bench's legitimacy
options.detail: Give the year to the bench's legitimacy. Steady — the philosophy simply waits.

options.label: Prioritize the philosophical writing
options.detail: Give the year to the work at its peak. The docket suffers; the philosophy doesn't.

choices.title: First inquisition: mode of defense

options.label: Rigorous legal/rhetorical defense
options.detail: Mount a rigorous legal defense alone — the harder, cleanest case to win.

options.label: Call in patron favor
options.detail: Call in Iskandar Sultan's old loyalty. Faster — and it spends a debt for good.

options.label: Attempt both at once
options.detail: Attempt both the legal defense and the patron's favor. Strongest combination, hardest to coordinate.

choices.title: First inquisition: recant or hold firm

options.label: Partial, face-saving recantation
options.detail: Offer a face-saving recantation. Ends this fast; you'll hear your own words for years.

options.label: Hold every position
options.detail: Hold every position without concession. Costly, and nothing you believe gets compromised.

choices.title: Second inquisition: distance from associates, or not

options.label: Preemptively distance from Qasim-i Anvar
options.detail: Distance yourself from Qasim-i Anvar under pressure. May save you — he will feel the betrayal.

options.label: Refuse to abandon anyone
options.detail: Refuse to abandon anyone. Principled — and the shared risk is now yours too.

choices.title: Third inquisition: bend the knee

options.label: Bend — survive compromised
options.detail: Bend the knee. You survive, diminished, having said less than the whole truth.

options.label: Hold firm (the historical choice)
options.detail: Hold firm, the historical choice. Whatever it costs, it isn't your integrity.

choices.title: Third inquisition: flee, or stand trial

options.label: Attempt to flee before judgment
options.detail: Attempt to flee before judgment. Undignified, uncertain, and alive to see what's next.

options.label: Stand and face the tribunal
options.detail: Stand and face the tribunal on your own name. No one can say you weren't there.

choices.title: Destination in exile

options.label: Seek patronage at the Aqquyunlu court
options.detail: Seek a new patron among the rival Aqquyunlu, betting your name outruns the scandal that far.

options.label: Retreat into pure private scholarship
options.detail: Retreat into private scholarship. Safe — the work goes only as far as you do.

options.label: Attempt reconciliation and return
options.detail: Attempt reconciliation toward Isfahan. Real vindication if it works, confirmation of the worst if not.

choices.title: Keep working, or go dark

options.label: Continue writing and teaching
options.detail: Keep writing and teaching in exile. Alive and visible — and reachable.

options.label: Go silent to protect what remains
options.detail: Go quiet to protect what remains. Safer; nothing new gets added.

choices.title: Entrust the manuscripts to Yazdi

options.label: Formally entrust the papers to Yazdi
options.detail: Formally entrust the papers to Yazdi at the Samarkand Observatory. The work has somewhere to go.

options.label: Keep them close
options.detail: Keep the papers close. They travel exactly as far as you do.

choices.note: Transmission completeness in the ending logic depends on c03: entrust+equal = full transmission, entrust+mentor = partial, keep = lost regardless of c03.

choices.title: How to face death

options.label: Reconciled and at peace
options.detail: Make peace with what this cost. It changes nothing — and it may be what matters most.

options.label: Embittered, railing against accusers
options.detail: Go out angry at your accusers. Not wrong — and it's what people will remember.

options.label: Defiantly triumphant
options.detail: Go out certain history will agree with you. Faith or prophecy — you won't learn which.

choices.title: The final testament

options.label: A public, defiant final statement
options.detail: Leave a public final statement on Investigations's fate. Condemned again, and therefore read.

options.label: Quiet transmission to the New Brethren only
options.detail: Leave a quiet transmission to the New Brethren alone. Small, and hard to burn.
